changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionMeasure') BEGIN CREATE TABLE api.ExecutionMeasure ( ExecutionID uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, ItemNumber int NOT NULL, MetricAssetUid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, Passed bit NOT NULL,
IsValidMetric bit NULL, IsValidVersion bit NULL,
ScoreUid uniqueidentifier NULL, ScoreItemUid uniqueidentifier NULL, MetricAssetVersionUid uniqueidentifier NULL,
CONSTRAINT PK_ApiExecutionMeasure PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( ExecutionID ASC, ItemNumber ASC, MetricAssetUid ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionMeasure_ExecutionID_ItemNumber') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionMeasure_ExecutionID_ItemNumber ON api.ExecutionMeasure ( ExecutionID ASC, ItemNumber ASC ) END
